Information
Points to Master: 25000
Passive: Toggle

Passive

[Passive, True] Spacetime Manipulation:

Obtain the Spacetime Manipulation extra skill on obtainment

[Passive, True] Absolute Coating:

The user gains 200 damage boost (250 when mastered) and applies Severance effect on hit, just like absolute severance

[Passive, In-slot] Seize:

The user's attacks have a 50% chance to steal 1.5% MP from the target to restore their own MP

Active

[ Active - Press ] Rob (Just like from Usurper, but ignores EP requirement.)

[ Active - Press ] Copy (Just like Usurper but can gain Resistances.)

[ Active - Press ] Force Takeover (Just like Usurper but Spirit Takeover works up to 90% of the EP)

[Active, Press] Absolute End:

Launches an invisible projectile that deals 300 damage (400 when mastered)

[Active, Press] Infinity Prison:

At the cost of 50,000MP + 10% of the Targets EP, imprisons the mob/player the player is looking at. Seals all movement, skill usage and healing. Drains MP from the trapped target at a rate of 100 per 10 ticks. Lasts for 300 seconds. Increases to 600 seconds with mastery - 20s cooldown - Goes on CD if you Miss (10s with Mastery).

[Active, Press] Time Leap:

The user can save the location they're at. If they are to die, they instead return to the saved Time Leap location, however all of Yog-Sothoth is set on a 500 second cooldown

[Active, Press] Reverse Fate(Requires Mastery, Requires Learning:

When used, the user saves the current state of all things withing sixty blocks. On a second use, it loads everything back to that state. (3 minute cooldown.)

[Active, Press] Time Stop (Requires Learning):

When used, it will stop time in the local area, rendering all things still. Time will be stopped for 10 Seconds. (15 when mastered) Some entities can bypass this, and moved in Stopped Time, if they have mastered Spacetime Manipulation, Have a Time Manipulation Skill or are a Time Soul.

This Also costs 250k MP to use

Information
Passive: True, In slot

"TIME; THOU SHALL FOLLOW MY COMMAND!!!" 

Passive

[Passive, True] Spacetime Domination - When Spacetime Manipulation is mastered, the user obtains Spacetime Domination.

[Passive, Toggle] Absolute Coating - The user gains 250 Damage Boost (300 when mastered) and applies Severance Effect on hit, just like Absolute Severance.

Actives

[Active, In-Slot] Usurping - The user's attacks have a 50% chance to steal 2% MP from the target to restore their own MP.

[Active, In-Slot] Absolute - Blocks all attacks with a formula of C = A * 15. C = Cost, A = Attack Damage. Attacks from an opponent with 75% or higher the user's EP can bypass it.

[Active, Press] Usurping - You can change the mode by using Shift + Press. While this mode is in-slot, [ Usurping ] is active. It has the following modes:

Robbery: The user can use Robbery on any target, to steal one of their skills. All Stolen Skills are temporary, only lasting for twenty minutes. This cannot copy Ultimate Skills.
Takeover: The user can use Takeover on any target, not just summoins, permitting Yog-Sotohort to temporary take over any target without Spiritual Attack Nullification or higher MP than the target's EP.

[Active, Press] Absolute - The user can swap between two modes. When this slot is in mode [ Absolute ] is in Slot.

Projectile: The user fires a severance cutter. It does 650 Damage.

Imprison: At the cost of 50,000MP + 10% of the Targets EP, imprisons the mob/player the player is looking at. Seals all movement, skill usage and healing. Drains MP from the trapped target at a rate of 100 per 10 ticks. Lasts for 300 seconds. Increases to 600 seconds with mastery - 20s cooldown - Goes on CD if you Miss (10s with Mastery).

[Active, Press] Courage - The user can swap between modes. The user gains two of these modes randomly when obtaining Yog-Sotohort.

Information
Points to Master: 5000
Passive: Toggle

Passive

[Passive, True] Divine Blessing of Faith - The user's max Spritirons is 1,500. You passively generate 15 Spiritrons a second.

[Passive, Toggled] Divine Blessing of Light - The user's attacks deal 50 Light Damage on hit. 100 when mastered.

[Passive, In-Slot] Divine Blessing of Future Sight - The user gains access to precognition, allowing them to randomly gain access to the Future Sight effect for five seconds.

Active

[Active, Press] Divine Creation - The user can open the Divine Creation Menu to open a list of blessings and create any blessing they want as a skill instead of an in-slot mode. When they shift use this, they delete any of the blessings instead. They can have a max of 5 blessings at a time. (Check Blessings)

[Active, Press] Divine Gift - The user can give 2 blessings to each of their subordinates. If they shift use the menu, they may revoke it. If this is used on an entity, not a player, the entity also gains the sentient skill.

[Active, In-slot/Press] Divine Blessing of The Paladin - While this mode is in-slot, the user deals 5% of their Spiritrons as Holy Damage and reduces all Holy Damage taken by their Spiriton amount while in slot.

When this mode is pressed, it instead gives Holy Weapon 5 to the weapon.

When the user has Divine Blessing of Gathering Spirits, they also reduce all the Elemental Damages by their Spiritron bar.
